description.id: Panduan pengantar tentang persiapan dan gambaran umum rangkaian ibadah haji.
description.en: An introductory guide to preparation and a general outline of the Hajj rites.

description.id: Haji diwajibkan sekali seumur hidup bagi Muslim yang mampu.
description.en: Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime for Muslims who are able.

translation.id: Pastikan kesiapan kesehatan dan biaya, urus dokumen serta pendaftaran melalui penyelenggara resmi, dan ikuti pengarahan manasik. Pelajari jadwal perjalanan, keselamatan, dan cara meminta bantuan. Ikuti petunjuk petugas haji karena kondisi lapangan dan aturan pemerintah dapat memengaruhi pelaksanaan.
translation.en: Confirm health and financial readiness, complete documents and registration through an authorized provider, and attend Hajj training. Learn the travel schedule, safety procedures, and how to ask for assistance. Follow Hajj officials' directions because conditions on the ground and government rules may affect arrangements.

description.id: Ihram dimulai dengan niat haji di miqat yang sesuai dengan rute perjalanan.
description.en: Ihram begins with the intention for Hajj at the miqat appropriate to the travel route.

translation.id: Aku penuhi panggilan-Mu, ya Allah, untuk berhaji.
translation.en: Here I am, O Allah, to perform Hajj.

description.id: Rangkaian haji meliputi beberapa amalan utama pada waktu dan tempat tertentu.
description.en: The Hajj rites include several main acts at appointed times and places.

translation.id: Secara umum, rangkaian haji meliputi wukuf di Arafah pada 9 Zulhijah, mabit di Muzdalifah, menuju Mina, melontar jumrah pada hari-hari yang ditentukan, tahallul, tawaf ifadah, dan sa'i bila menjadi bagian yang belum ditunaikan. Urutan dan waktu pelaksanaan dapat berbeda menurut jenis haji, keadaan jemaah, dan arahan resmi. Wukuf di Arafah merupakan rukun haji yang sangat penting.
translation.en: In general, the rites include standing at Arafah on 9 Dhu al-Hijjah, staying at Muzdalifah, proceeding to Mina, stoning the Jamarat on designated days, leaving ihram (tahallul), performing Tawaf al-Ifadah, and Sa'i if it remains to be completed. Order and timing may vary by Hajj type, the pilgrim's circumstances, and official directions. Standing at Arafah is an essential pillar of Hajj.

sources.reference: Sahih Muslim 1218 (description of the Prophet's Hajj)

description.id: Jaga kesabaran dan keselamatan diri serta jemaah lain selama haji.
description.en: Maintain patience and protect your safety and that of fellow pilgrims throughout Hajj.

translation.id: Jaga kesabaran, kebersihan, dan hak sesama jemaah. Hindari berdesakan atau mengambil risiko demi melakukan amalan sunah; ikuti jalur, waktu, dan instruksi petugas. Jaga kesehatan, minum cukup, dan segera minta bantuan bila sakit atau tersesat.
translation.en: Maintain patience, cleanliness, and consideration for fellow pilgrims. Avoid crowding or taking risks to perform optional acts; follow routes, schedules, and officials' instructions. Protect your health, drink enough, and promptly seek help if ill or lost.

description.id: Tanyakan ketentuan rinci kepada pembimbing haji untuk keadaan pribadi.
description.en: Ask a Hajj guide about detailed rulings for personal circumstances.

translation.id: Haji memiliki ketentuan rukun, wajib, sunah, dam, dan keringanan yang rinci. Jangan mengambil keputusan tentang dam, perubahan urutan, atau kondisi khusus hanya dari ringkasan ini. Tanyakan kepada pembimbing bersertifikat atau otoritas haji resmi.
translation.en: Hajj has detailed rulings concerning pillars, obligatory rites, recommended acts, compensatory offerings (dam), and concessions. Do not make decisions about dam, changes in sequence, or special circumstances based only on this overview. Ask a qualified guide or official Hajj authority.
